issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 requests the Anzahl (count) of swimming pools in Gemeinden with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution query returns the names of the Schwimmbäder instead of an aggregate count. This structural mismatch between the expected result type (a single numeric count) and the solution's output (multiple name rows) will confuse students about the intended output and cause automated checks to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to return the count instead of individual names. For example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000;
